_comment: Audit Deliveries: tiers 0 and 1 are open at start; tiers 2 and 3 need parts delivered at the warden terminal.

letter.title: Audit passed: Tier 2
letter.text: The wardens accept your delivery. Advanced machinery is cleared for use.

letter.title: Audit passed: Tier 3
letter.text: The wardens are impressed. High-throughput industry is cleared for use.

participation_ribbon.title: Participation Ribbon
participation_ribbon.text: Someone survived a raid. The wardens note that attendance is attendance.

clean_hands.title: Clean Hands
clean_hands.text: Plenty of ore dug, nothing refined. The planet quietly approves.

mass_disappointment.title: Mass Disappointment
mass_disappointment.text: Three knock-downs so far. The warden sighs on your behalf.

debt_enthusiast.title: Debt Enthusiast
debt_enthusiast.text: 500 ore mined. Your debt is thrilled with the commitment.

toast_master.title: Toast Master
toast_master.text: Twenty creatures toasted. The colony raises a glass.

reviews.title: Parole Review I
reviews.text: Early repayments are noted. The wardens grant a small essence allowance.

reviews.title: Parole Review II
reviews.text: The colony held against the creatures. The wardens release a research allowance.

reviews.title: Parole Review III
reviews.text: The debt book looks healthier. The wardens approve a final allowance.

k2_reviews.title: Parole Review IV
k2_reviews.text: An outpost has held. The wardens note the colony can survive off its own land.

e3_reviews.title: Parole Review IV: Ledger
e3_reviews.text: A quarter of the debt book is cleared. Audits will come a day later.

e3_reviews.title: Parole Review V: Range
e3_reviews.text: Spare power and a clean sky. The wardens grant you rank and another quiet day.
